verdict.rationale: Persona's Workflows feature explicitly automates repetitive manual decisions and reduces manual review time, and Reports can be configured to run at regular intervals against an account, with webhooks notifying external services of events — together these describe background automations that run without human intervention. However, this is domain-specific (identity/compliance decisioning) rather than general-purpose agentic automation, and there's no detail on configuring custom triggers/schedules beyond report intervals or on AI-driven logic within workflows. Missing for 10: evidence of flexible triggering/scheduling UI or API for arbitrary automations, AI-native automation configuration, and independent/hands-on confirmation of autonomous operation.
